Customer Support Agent - LATAM (all genders)

Distribusion Technologies

Países permitidosMéxico, Chile, Colombia, Brasil, LATAM
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)
Idioma requeridoInglés y Español
ExperienciaSolid Customer Service experience (partner support, live chat & phone)
SalarioCompetitive

Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Support global ground transportation partners and users in English and Spanish across email, live chat, and phone for a leading travel tech platform.

Funciones principales

  • Handle incoming English and Spanish requests regarding bookings, fraud, and technical issues via email, live chat, and phone.
  • Collaborate closely with tech, product, retail, and finance teams to resolve partner inquiries.
  • Drive process improvements and advocate for feature enhancements.

Requisitos

  • Solid experience in Customer Service (partner relationship management, live chat, and phone support are a plus).
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish.
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills.
  • Nice to have: technical troubleshooting (reading API logs and writing basic SQL queries).

Beneficios

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work across Chile, Colombia, Mexico, or Brazil.
  • International tech environment working with partners like Booking.com and Google Maps.
  • Relocation opportunities and strong room for growth.
